title: Review Output
description: Unified schema for all principle review outputs. Each principle key inside 'metrics' follows that principle's own review/output.schema.json.

line_start.description: Optional start line of this unit in the source file. Used for changed-range filtering.

line_end.description: Optional end line of this unit in the source file. Used for changed-range filtering.

metrics.description: Keys are principle names (e.g. 'SRP', 'OCP'). Each value follows that principle's review/output.schema.json (metrics sub-object schema).

additionalProperties.description: Principle-specific metrics. Each key is a metric variable name; each value has a required 'value' field and an optional 'additional-info' field.

value.description: Measured metric value scored against severity bands.

additional-info.description: Optional opaque context (verb tables, group lists, sealed lists, etc.). Passed through to output unchanged; never read by the scorer.

violations.description: Server-generated. Do not include in submissions — the server fills this after scoring.

rule_id.description: Rule identifier that fired, e.g. 'SRP-1', 'OCP-2'. Encodes the principle by prefix.
